title: Dose, tamp, and lock
task: dosing, tamping, and locking in an espresso portafilter
setting: Top-down POV of a cafe espresso station on a light wood counter: a grinder beside a La Marzocco machine, knock box with spent grounds, metal tamper, syrup pumps, stacked cups, and a towel. The barista has tattooed forearms and wears a black long sleeve.

steps.text: Dose and grind espresso into the portafilter
steps.detail: The barista holds the portafilter under the grinder while grounds fill the basket, hands moving between the grinder, knock box, and counter.
steps.expected: Dose and grind into the portafilter basket; this is the correct first action.

steps.text: Lock the portafilter into the group head
steps.detail: The grounds-filled portafilter is carried to the La Marzocco and twisted into the group head with the coffee bed still loose and mounded.
flags: locked in without tamping; loose mounded grounds visible
steps.expected: The grounds must be TAMPED flat and firm BEFORE the portafilter goes into the group head. Locking in a loose, untamped bed is out of order.

steps.detail: The barista’s hand rests near the knock box while the portafilter stays locked in the machine off to the right.
steps.expected: Nothing should be resting in the group head untamped; the puck should have been tamped before locking in.

steps.detail: The portafilter is removed from the group head and brought over the counter, still showing an untamped bed of grounds.
steps.expected: Pulling the portafilter back out is the correction for having locked it in untamped.

steps.text: Tamp the grounds level and firm
steps.detail: The tamper is picked up and pressed straight down into the portafilter basket against the counter edge.
steps.expected: Tamp the bed flat and firm, tamper level, against a stable surface.

steps.text: Lock the tamped portafilter into the group head
steps.detail: The tamped portafilter is carried back to the La Marzocco and locked into the group head with a firm twist.
steps.expected: Lock the now-tamped portafilter into the group head — this is the correct order.

steps.detail: Hands come to rest near the knock box as the corrected, locked-in setup sits on the machine.
steps.expected: With the tamped portafilter locked in, the shot should be started promptly.

procedure: Dose and grind the coffee into the portafilter basket.
Level or distribute the grounds so the bed is even.
Tamp the bed flat and firm with the tamper before it goes anywhere near the machine.
Lock the tamped portafilter into the group head with a firm twist.
Start the shot promptly so the puck is not left sitting hot in the group.
